title: The Last Contract
summary: At the roots of the Tree of Origin, Ha-Jun and Kuro dissolve the ancient master-servant contract, rewriting their bond into an eternal covenant of equals.

panels.shot: the roots of the tree of origin: colossal woven bridges of pure starlight
panels.action: Massive roots of living crystal starlight intertwine across an ocean of infinite cosmic clouds.
panels.prose_en: Massive roots of living crystal starlight intertwine across an ocean of infinite cosmic clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Jeevit crystal starlite ki vishal jaden anant brahmandiya baadalon ke mahasagar mein aapas mein judi hui han.

panels.shot: floating in the center: the ancient contract parchment of episode 2
panels.action: Hovering between Ha-Jun and Kuro is the original demonic pact from Episode 2, written in glowing crimson blood runes.

dialogue.text: The Contract of Blood: 'Power has a price.'

panels.prose_en: Hovering between Ha-Jun and Kuro is the original demonic pact from Episode 2, written in glowing crimson blood runes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur kuro ke beech mandrana episode 2 ka mool rakshasi samjhauta hai, jo chamakte lal rang ke rakt runon mein likha gaya hai.

panels.shot: kuro standing on the crystal root his feathers glowing with divine violet flame
panels.action: Kuro tilts his head, his ruby eyes reflecting the ancient parchment: 'The contract was written when you were weak.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: It demanded sacrifice, pain, and blood. Because Asmodaius knew no other way.

panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his head, his ruby eyes reflecting the ancient parchment: 'The contract was written when you were weak.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apna sir jhukata hai, uski lal aankhen prachin charmpatra ko pratibimbit karti han: 'anubandh tab likha gaya tha jab aap kamjor the.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping forward placing his bare palm over the ancient crimson runes
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the paper; warm golden mana washes over the harsh red lettering, softening its jagged edges.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The old covenant is fulfilled. Today, we write a new one.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the paper; warm golden mana washes over the harsh red lettering, softening its jagged edges.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kagaj ko chhuta hai; garm sunhara maina kathor lal aksharon par dhul jata hai, jisse iske dantedar kinare naram ho jaate han.

panels.shot: tae-jun watching from the crystal bridge with folded arms smiling
panels.action: Tae-Jun watches with pride: 'A contract of equals. No masters. No servants.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun watches with pride: 'A contract of equals. No masters. No servants.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun garv ke saath dekhta hai: 'barabri ka anubandh. koi swami nahin. koi naukar nahin.'

panels.shot: the crimson blood runes dissolving into golden starlight ink
panels.action: The red ink transforms into flowing stardust gold; the words dissolve into blank, waiting parchment.
panels.prose_en: The red ink transforms into flowing stardust gold; the words dissolve into blank, waiting parchment.
panels.prose_hi: Lal syahi bahte hue stardust sone mein badal jaati hai; shabd rikt, pratiksharat charmpatra mein vilin ho jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing a single golden thread of mana from his heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws a luminous thread of golden sovereign mana from his chest, using it as a pen.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws a luminous thread of golden sovereign mana from his chest, using it as a pen.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni chhati se sunhare samprabhu man ka ek chamakdar dhaga khinchta hai, ise ek kalam ke roop mein upyog karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro plucking a single soft black down-feather from his wing
panels.action: Kuro plucks a soft, downy feather from his breast, offering the quill to Ha-Jun: 'Use this, my brother.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro plucks a soft, downy feather from his breast, offering the quill to Ha-Jun: 'Use this, my brother.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne seene se ek naram, komal pankh nikala aur kalam ko ha-jun ki or badhate hue kaha: 'iska upyog karo, mere bhai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun taking the feather writing upon the starlight parchment
panels.action: With a gentle, elegant hand, Ha-Jun writes the new covenant in radiant script.

dialogue.text: 'We walk as brothers. We share the light. Neither shall bow to the other.'

panels.prose_en: With a gentle, elegant hand, Ha-Jun writes the new covenant in radiant script.
panels.prose_hi: Saumya, suruchipoorn haath se, ha-jun nai vacha ko ujjwal lipi mein likhta hai.

panels.shot: kuro pressing his talon against the signature line
panels.action: Kuro presses his talon onto the gold wax seal: 'Agreed. Throughout time and eternity.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro presses his talon onto the gold wax seal: 'Agreed. Throughout time and eternity.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne sone ki mom ki seal par apna panja dabaya: 'sahmat. poore samay aur anant kaal tak.'

panels.shot: the parchment dissolving into a dazzling wave of warm purple and gold sparks
panels.action: The treaty dissolves into a shower of warm light that sinks into both Ha-Jun and Kuro's chests.
panels.prose_en: The treaty dissolves into a shower of warm light that sinks into both Ha-Jun and Kuro's chests.
panels.prose_hi: Sandhi garm roshni ki bauchhar mein vilin ho jaati hai jo ha-jun aur kuro donon ke seene mein sama jaati hai.

panels.shot: kuro body dissolving into a cloak of living starlight feathers
panels.action: Kuro's physical form transforms into a magnificent royal mantle of midnight-black starlight feathers draping Ha-Jun's shoulders.

dialogue.text: THE MANTLE OF THE NETHER PHOENIX.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's physical form transforms into a magnificent royal mantle of midnight-black starlight feathers draping Ha-Jun's shoulders.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka bhautik roop ha-jun ke kandhon par lipte madhyaratri-kale taron ke pankhon ke ek shandar shahi aavaran mein badal jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro voice echoing warmly inside ha-jun mind: 'i am with you, always'
panels.action: Kuro's voice resonates with infinite comfort: 'I am your wings, Ha-Jun. Fly.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro's voice resonates with infinite comfort: 'I am your wings, Ha-Jun. Fly.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki awaz aseem aaram se gunjati hai: 'main tumhare pankh hun, ha-jun. udna.'.

panels.shot: the roots of the tree of origin pulsing in thunderous welcome
panels.action: The colossal crystal roots hum an ancient chord of welcome as the final bloodline synchronization unlocks.
panels.prose_en: The colossal crystal roots hum an ancient chord of welcome as the final bloodline synchronization unlocks.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi antim bladlin synchronization unlock hota hai, vishal crystal jaden swagat ka ek prachin raag gunjayman karti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping toward the central heart chamber of the tree
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks toward the core chamber, his starlight feather cloak billowing, eyes shining like twin suns.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks toward the core chamber, his starlight feather cloak billowing, eyes shining like twin suns.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun mukhya kaksh ki or chalta hai, uska taron jaisa pankhon wala labada lahra raha hai, aankhen judwan suraj ki tarah chamak rahi han.

panels.shot: tae-jun walking beside him placing his hand on the heart threshold
panels.action: Tae-Jun stands at the entrance: 'Go inside, Ha-Jun. Claim your true form.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Apna poora roop le lo. I will watch the gate.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun stands at the entrance: 'Go inside, Ha-Jun. Claim your true form.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun pravesh dwar par khada hai: 'ander jao, ha-jun. apne asli swaroop ka dawa karen.'

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding smiling warmly at tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles: 'See you in a minute, Hyung.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles: 'See you in a minute, Hyung.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun muskurata hai: 'ek minute mein milte han, hung.'

panels.shot: ha-jun entering the heart chamber of the tree: a sphere of pure starlight
panels.action: Inside the sphere: total weightlessness surrounded by the birth of newborn galaxies and stars.
panels.prose_en: Inside the sphere: total weightlessness surrounded by the birth of newborn galaxies and stars.
panels.prose_hi: Gole ke ander: navjaat akashgangaon aur taron ke janm se ghiri hui kul bharahinta.

panels.shot: in the center of the chamber: the sovereign pillar of creation
panels.action: A slender needle of pure crystalline diamond light that anchors all universal laws.
panels.prose_en: A slender needle of pure crystalline diamond light that anchors all universal laws.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh crystaliy heere ki roshni ki ek patli sui jo sabhi sarvbhaumik kanunon ko sthapit karti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun floating up to the pillar his hands outstretched
panels.action: Ha-Jun floats up, his open palms hovering inches away from the sacred diamond pillar.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This is where our story ends... And our eternal peace begins.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun floats up, his open palms hovering inches away from the sacred diamond pillar.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun upar tairta hai, uski khuli hatheliyan pavitra heere ke stambh se kuch inch ki doori par mandara rahi han.

panels.shot: ha-jun fingers touching the crystalline surface of the pillar
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingertips make contact with the pillar; an instantaneous shockwave of celestial mana explodes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingertips make contact with the pillar; an instantaneous shockwave of celestial mana explodes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki ungaliyan khambhe se sampark banati han; akashiya man ki ek tatkalik shockwev visphotit hoti hai.

panels.shot: a blinding cascade of white and royal violet light washing over his body
panels.action: Blinding sovereign light washes over him, dissolving all remaining mortal fatigue and limits.
panels.prose_en: Blinding sovereign light washes over him, dissolving all remaining mortal fatigue and limits.
panels.prose_hi: Us par chakachaundh kar dene wali samprabhu roshni barasti hai, shesh sabhi nashwar thakan aur seemaon ko bhang kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hair growing longer, flowing with living starlight and constellations
panels.action: His hair flows down to his shoulders, midnight-black shot through with spinning galaxies and platinum comets.
panels.prose_en: His hair flows down to his shoulders, midnight-black shot through with spinning galaxies and platinum comets.
panels.prose_hi: Uske bal uske kandhon tak lahrate han, aadhi raat ke kale rang mein ghumte hue akashgangaon aur platinum dhumketuon ke saath guzrte han.

panels.shot: two golden sovereign horns curving gracefully from his temples
panels.action: Two elegant, noble horns of white jade and gold starlight curve back gracefully from his brow.
panels.prose_en: Two elegant, noble horns of white jade and gold starlight curve back gracefully from his brow.
panels.prose_hi: Safed jed aur sone ki taron ki roshni ke do sunder, mahan seeng uske mathe se sundar dhang se peeche ki or mude hue han.

panels.shot: six colossal wings of creation expanding from his back
panels.action: Six magnificent wings unfold—refracting the entire spectrum of cosmic dawn, spanning a hundred yards.
panels.prose_en: Six magnificent wings unfold—refracting the entire spectrum of cosmic dawn, spanning a hundred yards.
panels.prose_hi: Chhah shandar pankh khule hue hain - brahmandiya bhor ke poore spectrum ko apvartit karte hue, sau gaj ki doori tak faile hue.

panels.shot: the ten relics permanently manifesting as ten spinning celestial halos behind him
panels.action: Ten concentric halos of living light rotate behind his back, each bearing the emblem of a purified relic.
panels.prose_en: Ten concentric halos of living light rotate behind his back, each bearing the emblem of a purified relic.
panels.prose_hi: Jivit prakash ke das sankendrit prabhamandal uski peeth ke peeche ghumte han, jinmein se pratyek par ek shuddh avashesh ka prateek hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes: irises containing the birth of new universes
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes open: deep royal violet irises holding infinite compassion, wisdom, and eternal peace.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes open: deep royal violet irises holding infinite compassion, wisdom, and eternal peace.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki aankhen khulin: gahre shahi baingani rang ki putli mein anant karuna, gyan aur shashwat shanti hai.

panels.shot: system interface flashing for the final time then dissolving into starlight
panels.action: The system interface appears: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 100.0% - TRUE SOVEREIGN METAMORPHOSIS COMPLETE]'.

dialogue.text: The system dissolved. He was no longer a vessel. He was the Sovereign.

panels.prose_en: The system interface appears: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 100.0% - TRUE SOVEREIGN METAMORPHOSIS COMPLETE]'.
panels.prose_hi: Sistm interface prakat hota hai: '[bladlin sinkronization: 100.0% - true sovereign metamorfosis purn]'.

panels.shot: the black wound on the world tree sealing completely with golden sap
panels.action: Outside in the garden, the 5,000-year-old black fissure on the World Tree seals shut forever with golden sap.
panels.prose_en: Outside in the garden, the 5,000-year-old black fissure on the World Tree seals shut forever with golden sap.
panels.prose_hi: Bagiche ke bahar, world tree seals par 5,000 saal purani kali daraar sunhare ras ke saath hamesha ke liye band ho gai.

panels.shot: the true sovereign stepping out from the chamber in full divine glory cliffhanger
panels.action: Kang Ha-Jun steps out onto the crystal bridge in his True Sovereign Form—transcendent, beautiful, and eternal!

dialogue.text: THE TRUE DEMON SOVEREIGN HAS ASCENDED.

panels.prose_en: Kang Ha-Jun steps out onto the crystal bridge in his True Sovereign Form—transcendent, beautiful, and eternal!.
panels.prose_hi: Cong ha-jun apne sacche samprabhu roop mein crystal bridge par kadam rakhta hai - utkrisht, sundar aur shashwat!
